# guide-builder

> An open-source agent skill (MIT, by MakerLab Perú) that helps teachers, mentors and volunteers prepare a step-by-step guide to support their workshop. The agent defines the scope with the author in rounds of questions, runs every step for real, takes the screenshots, and publishes a self-paced page with copy buttons, progress, a "Done, next step" button and a phone layout. Works with Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode.

Install: `npx skills add MakerLabPeru/guide-builder-skill`

Call it from your agent:
- Claude Code: `/guide-builder A guide about [topic], for [audience].`
- Codex: `$guide-builder A guide about [topic], for [audience].`
- OpenCode: `/guide-builder A guide about [topic], for [audience].`

Update: `npx skills update guide-builder`
